author: Fxcommander
quote: I’m about 40% into GTA 6 and I genuinely can’t believe this is what we waited 13 years for. The pacing is terrible, the characters are boring and the story just doesn’t interest me at all. It feels like absolutely nothing is happening. Half the time I’m just doing random errands or following some relationship drama I couldn’t care less about.I get what Rockstar was trying to do. They clearly went for that slower Red Dead Redemption style of storytelling, but this is GTA for **** sake. I want crime, chaos, funny characters and crazy missions. Not some slow-paced love story. And it’s not even just the story. The world itself doesn’t really impress me either. The game isn’t funny, it isn’t exciting and I honestly don’t feel motivated to keep playing.I spent an insane amount of time playing GTA 5 and that game was an absolute masterpiece compared to this. The characters, the humor, the missions, everything just worked.I’ll finish GTA 6 because I’ve already started it, but man, what a disappointment. After 13 years I expected so much more.
